questions.question: How does David describe his distress in Psalm 69?
options: The waters have come up to his neck; he sinks in deep mire
He walks at ease through a garden full of fruit
His table is spread before him in a place of plenty
He rests in green pastures beside still and quiet waters
questions.answer: The waters have come up to his neck; he sinks in deep mire

questions.question: What consumed David, which is quoted in the New Testament?
David says they gave him poison for food and sour wine to drink.
Save me, O God! For the _____ have come up to my neck.
